props.value: In the context of this profile, the objective of this control is to achieve consistent labeling of Protected B material to the maximum extent supported by available, automated mechanisms (for example, email system enforcing classification labels). Since not all information on the system will be sensitive, labeling will help prevent the accidental distribution of Protected B information by providing filter mechanisms with a differentiator.
